subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — follow up + numbers

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the questions we promised to follow up on so we can build a tight hosted API quote: 

- Expected monthly token volume (approx): you mentioned production would ramp over Q2 — can you confirm an expected steady-state monthly token volume and an optimistic peak month?
- Peak TPS (concurrent requests / tokens-per-second expectation): we need this to size headroom and latency SLOs.
- Target unit economics: you said you have an internal shadow target of ~$XX per 1M tokens; can you share the target $/1M tokens or a budget range for inference?

If you can reply with the numbers below that would be ideal: monthly tokens (avg), peak month tokens, peak TPS, target $/1M tokens, and any billing constraints (PO vs card). I attached a short usage export we pulled from your trial for reference.

Next steps: once we have these, Marissa and I will turn around a hosted quote + recommended batch/quantization profile + expected monthly cost range and a HS quote link.

Thanks —
Sean
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightCommerce_usage_snapshot.csv (csv, 42KB)
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brightcommerce.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — follow up + numbers

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the recap — here are the numbers from our side after syncing with engineering and finance: 

- Average monthly tokens (current production): ~25M tokens/month
- Expected steady-state after Q2 rollout: 150M tokens/month
- Optimistic peak month (holiday promo): 320M tokens
- Peak TPS (short bursts): ~55 TPS sustained for short windows (~1-2 min), avg steady-state TPS ~12
- Target spend: finance is looking for $600–900/month initially during pilot and budgeted target of $4k–5k/month for steady state. Their preferred unit target is about $0.75–$1.25 per 1M tokens for evaluation purposes (open to discussion).

Billing: procurement prefers invoice/PO for enterprise work.

Let me know if you need any more detail. We can also share a higher-granularity token histogram if helpful.

Best,
Samantha
Head of AI Products, BrightCommerce
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — follow up + numbers

Sean —

Thanks for the thread. Based on the numbers (150M steady, 320M peak) and procurement needing PO invoicing, we should prepare two items:

1) A hosted API quote (HubSpot) with a pilot tier that hits the $600–900/mo constraint for the initial months — we can do a time-limited pilot discount or committed-minimum for month 1–3.
2) A steady-state estimate and recommended configuration: batching/kv-cache + a T4/NVIDIA A100 variant suggestion (we should call out unit economics: ~$X per 1M tokens at default config and the reductions with 8-bit quantization + caching).

Can you confirm whether BrightCommerce needs streaming & function-calling (they said yes on call) — that'll affect token count + latency SLO. Also adding the RDW proposed quote PDF to share with procurement.

I'll build the HubSpot quote draft (link to follow) — want me to propose a 3-month pilot at $750/mo capped, then transition to usage-based with a target $/1M tokens in the 0.9–1.2 range?

-Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW_proposed_quote_BrightCommerce.pdf (pdf, 180KB)
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@brightcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — follow up + numbers

Hi Marissa / Sean —

Thanks — confirmed on streaming & function-calling; both are required. Pilot approach sounds good. Procurement is OK with a 3-month pilot budgeted at $750/mo (PO to follow). After pilot, finance wants a usage-based plan targeting ~$1.00 per 1M tokens once steady state is reached; they understand discounts for committed volume.

Next steps from our side: I will share a PO template and a more detailed token histogram by EOD Friday. From RDW side, please share the HubSpot quote + the DocuSign for the pilot so procurement can sign.

Cheers,
Samantha
Head of AI Products, BrightCommerce
